# SIWC adaptation notices

Native authentication/OIDC/secure storage, account models, SSE decoding and their
focused tests are selectively adapted from
https://github.com/khuongnd0901/Dex-Assistant-UI at
`a52ddf0ecf3022922401f222f4db2d71282d3a9d` (MIT,
[dex-assistant-ui-LICENSE](dex-assistant-ui-LICENSE)). That implementation adapts
ChatGPT-Subscription-Android-POC; its original
[siwc-poc-LICENSE](siwc-poc-LICENSE) is retained as well.

No Assistant device automation, stored credentials, client registration or account
artifacts are included. Kids owns an independent Android Keystore alias, local
host identity and OAuth registration. Product assets retain their existing notices.
